## Backend Rules (backend/**)

- **Layer Boundaries**: Never import from `@/frontend/**` or `@/app/**`.
- **Types**: All DB/Service/API types must come from `@/backend/types/{entity}.types.ts`. Do not define inline types in Pothos resolvers.
- **Transactions**: Inside transactions, pass `tx` to all repository method calls. Never mix `db` and `tx`.
- **Logging**: Use `import { logger } from "@/backend/lib/logger"`. Expected rejections use `logger.logDomainError(msg, ctx)`.
